<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_TicketBooking" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_TicketBooking" name="Ticket Booking and Travel" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Main">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Search</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SearchTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectRoute</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvidePersonalPayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TravelJourney</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Feedback_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideFeedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Feedback_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_JourneyCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BookingSystem" name="Booking System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Ticket_Fork</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Ticket_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Reminder_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendReminder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Reminder_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_TravelCompany" name="Travel Company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateInventory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Search" name="Customer starts ticket search">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SearchTicket" name="Search for flight, train or bus ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectRoute" name="Select route, date and time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvidePersonalPayment" name="Provide personal information and payment details">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Ticket_Fork" name="Ticket generated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicket" name="Send ticket to customer via email or SMS">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Ticket_Join" name="Ticket sent and inventory updated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Reminder_Split" name="Reminders sent?" default="Flow_12">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReminder" name="Send reminders and check-in or boarding instructions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Reminder_Merge" name="Before travel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_TravelJourney" name="Complete journey">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Split" name="Post-travel feedback or services?" default="Flow_17">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Provide post-travel feedback or use post-travel services">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Merge" name="Feedback handled or skipped">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_JourneyCompleted" name="Process concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Search" targetRef="Task_SearchTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SearchTicket" targetRef="Task_SelectRoute"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SelectRoute" targetRef="Task_ProvidePersonalPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePersonalPayment" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Gateway_Ticket_Fork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_Ticket_Fork" targetRef="Task_SendTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_Ticket_Fork" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Gateway_Ticket_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_Ticket_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_Ticket_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Reminder_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_Reminder_Split" targetRef="Task_SendReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_Reminder_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Reminder_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="Gateway_Reminder_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_Reminder_Merge" targetRef="Task_TravelJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_TravelJourney" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge" targetRef="EndEvent_JourneyCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
